balk.definition:
n. the area on a billiard table behind the balkline
n. an illegal pitching motion while runners are on base
balk.translation:
n. 障碍, 错误, 失败
vt. 阻止, 错过, 推诿
vi. 逡巡不前

balka.translation:
n. 平谷
n. (Balka)人名；(阿拉伯)巴勒卡

balkan.definition: n. an inhabitant of the Balkan Peninsula

balkan frame.translation: [医] 巴尔干夹板(用于骨折,作伸展之用)

balkan mountains.translation: 巴尔干山脉（位于欧洲巴尔干半岛东部）

balkan splint.translation: [医] 巴尔干夹(用于骨折,作伸展用)

balkan wars.translation: 巴尔干战争[指1912～1913年的第一次巴尔干战争(First Balkan War)和1913年的第二次巴尔干战争(Second Balkan War)]

balkanise.definition: v divide a territory into small, hostile states

balkanization.translation: n. 分割成小国, 割据

balkanize.definition: v. divide a territory into small, hostile states
balkanize.translation: vt. 分割成小国, 使割据

balkanized.definition: v divide a territory into small, hostile states
balkanized.translation:
vt. 使分裂成若干对立的小国；使割据
vi. 分割成小国；割据

balkanizes.translation: v. 使（某地区）分成若干敌对的小国，使巴尔干化( Balkanize的第三人称单数 )

balkanizing.translation: v. 使（某地区）分成若干敌对的小国，使巴尔干化( Balkanize的现在分词 )

balkans.definition:
n. the major mountain range of Bulgaria and the Balkan Peninsula
n. the Balkan countries collectively
balkans.translation: n. 巴尔干半岛各国；巴尔干半岛地区

balked.translation: v. 畏缩不前, 犹豫( balk的过去式和过去分词 ); （指马）不肯跑

balker.definition:
n. One who, or that which balks.
n. A person who stands on a rock or eminence to espy the
   shoals of herring, etc., and to give notice to the men in boats which
   way they pass; a conder; a huer.

balkh.translation: n. 大夏（今巴尔克, 阿富汗北部城镇）

balkhash.translation: 巴尔喀什湖[哈萨克东南部](中国古称夷播海)

balkhash, lake.translation: 巴尔喀什湖(哈萨克斯坦东南部的咸水湖；中国古称夷播湖)

balkier.definition: s. stopping short and refusing to go on
balkier.translation: 固执的,不听人言的(比较级)

balkiest.definition: s. stopping short and refusing to go on
balkiest.translation: 固执的,不听人言的(最高级)

balkiness.definition: n. likely to stop abruptly and unexpectedly

balking.definition: s. stopping short and refusing to go on

balkingly.definition: adv. In a manner to balk or frustrate.

balkline.definition: n. line across a billiard table behind which the cue balls are placed at the start of a game
balkline.translation: 田径赛中的起跑线, 运动员脚踏上线（即犯规的线）

balks.definition:
n the area on a billiard table behind the balkline
n something immaterial that interferes with or delays action or progress
n one of several parallel sloping beams that support a roof
n an illegal pitching motion while runners are on base
v refuse to comply
balks.translation: v. 畏缩不前, 犹豫( balk的第三人称单数 ); （指马）不肯跑

balky.definition: s stopping short and refusing to go on
